title: BUZZY: Contrastive Scoring to Mitigate Text-Induced Bias in Multimodal Multiple-Choice QA
abstract: arXiv:2603.28026v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) provides a standardized and objectively measurable setting for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs). However, because the MCQA format incorporates the candidate choices into the input context, it introduces several unintended biases. Previous work has primarily focused on structural biases, such as preferences for certain choices. Instead, we argue that the choices act as textual priors, causing models to favor linguistically plausible options regardless of the visual content. We hypothesize and empirically verify that a model genuinely relies on visual evidence only when its multimodal distribution significantly diverges from its text-only distribution. Based on this observation we propose BUZZY,a training-free decoding method that corrects multimodal predictions by subtracting the text-only distribution. translated_title: BUZZY：对比评分以缓解多模态选择题问答中的文本诱导偏差
translated_abstract: 多模态选择题问答（MCQA）为评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了一个标准化且可客观测量的设置。然而，由于MCQA格式将候选选项纳入输入上下文，它引入了若干非预期偏差。先前的工作主要关注结构偏差，如对某些选项的偏好。相反，我们认为选项充当文本先验，导致模型倾向于语言上合理的选项，而忽略视觉内容。我们假设并实证验证，仅当模型的多模态分布与仅文本分布显著偏离时，它才真正依赖视觉证据。基于这一观察，我们提出了BUZZY，一种无需训练的解码方法，通过减去仅文本分布来纠正多模态预测。在五个多模态MCQA基准上使用五个VLMs的实验表明，该方法有效。
tldr: BUZZY通过对比评分，减去文本仅分布来纠正多模态预测，有效缓解了多模态选择题问答中的文本诱导偏差。
en_tdlr: BUZZY corrects multimodal predictions by subtracting text-only distribution via contrastive scoring, effectively mitigating text-induced bias in multimodal MCQA.
